reasoning: This gazette content primarily involves the exercise of statutory powers under the Industrial Disputes Act to appoint arbitrators for industrial disputes. It contains legal orders made under specific legislative authority (Section 4(1) of the Industrial Disputes Act), references to legislative enactments and amendments, and formal legal procedures for dispute resolution. While it mentions a government minister (Manusha Nanayakkara), this is in the context of exercising legal powers rather than personnel changes or portfolio descriptions, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette rather than a government personnel or hybrid type.
